name: Chart/Area-Chart
description:
Area chart: one measure over time as a 2px line (Color Chart Sector/Primary) over a 30% fade of its colour (its Solid at the line to its Subtle at the baseline); Type=Stacked stacks 2–4 series as bands, each with its top line, and a legend. 6–12 periods on a dashed grid with a solid baseline, the last point marked with a Dot, Rule and Tooltip.


Properties
Type: Area (one series) · Stacked (2–4 series that add up)
Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (the first two lines and fades swap; one area draws a Secondary line over the Neutral fade), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary"
Header: Show Icon · Title (Body/Extra/Medium) · Show Description (Body/Small/Regular) · Show Value (Display/4) · Show Ranges (Segmented) · Show Open, as on Chart-Card


Rules
Draws no surface of its own: it sits in a Card's Content slot, and the Card's Theme, Surface and Color give the widget its surface by the Card rules for the page's Canvas (Default, Shadow, Border, Flat-Border, Pale or Subtle; Solid for the one widget that stands out). No gradient surface.
Marks take the Color Chart Sector styles in chartPalette order; on a Solid card, the Color Chart Sector/On-Color styles.


Code: <AreaChart> in a <ChartCard> (Zen DS)
